title: Carry-On
description: A weekend bag waits on the airport belt. Run your pointer over it and an ink-like X-ray bloom spreads from your path, showing what is packed inside in scanner colours: a loaded camera, a mixtape, house keys, headphones, a paperback. Hold still on something to read what it is; let go and it heals shut in about a second.
intent: One fun mechanic on one real object: a cheap fake fluid that creeps outward in noisy fingers like ink in blotting paper and always heals, revealing a second drawing of the same bag in true screener colours where overlapping things get denser.

sources.name: Cullen Webber, Skeleton Fluid X-Ray Reveal (Codrops)
sources.what: Re-derived (no licence file): the round-capped canvas stroke from a lagging point whose opacity rises and falls by 0.1 per frame, the ping-pong mask that keeps the darkest of five fbm-offset taps, and the +0.015 per frame heal. Added a steady lens under a still pointer so a hovered item stays visible.

sources.name: Airport X-ray false colour
sources.what: The screener palette: orange for organic, green for plastics and mixed, blue to near-black for metals, multiplied where things overlap.
